#### Nov 10, 2026


# Ingevity CEO, Dave Li, to Receive the Chemists’ Club 2026 Winthrop-Sears Award


##### PRESS RELEASE


New York, NY October 29, 2026 – The Chemists’ Club is pleased to announce that the 2026 Winthrop-Sears Award recipient is David H. Li, CEO of Ingevity. The award will be presented to Mr. Li at the Chemists’ Club’s annual Egg Nog Gala on Thursday, December 10, 2026 at The Players, a historic club in New York City.


Established in 1970, the Winthrop-Sears Medal is presented each year to an individual whose entrepreneurial achievement has contributed to the vitality of the chemical industry and the betterment of humanity. It is named for two of America’s earliest chemical entrepreneurs: John Winthrop, Jr., considered the first chemist in America, and John Sears, creator of the Massachusetts salt industry.


The Chemists’ Club selected Mr. Li in recognition of his record of building and reshaping businesses for higher value. Under Mr. Li’s leadership, Ingevity has been transformed into a focused, high-margin specialty materials company, whose activated carbon technologies advance sustainability through emissions control and filtration. Previously, as CEO of CMC Materials, Mr. Li drove record revenue growth and profitability, accelerated innovation, and strengthened the company’s market leadership, creating substantial shareholder value and ultimately culminating in its acquisition by Entegris.


“I am honored by this recognition and grateful to be included among so many accomplished leaders,” said Mr. Li. “Throughout my career, I’ve had the privilege of working with remarkable people around the world and contributing to technologies and solutions that improve everyday life. I share this honor with the teams, mentors, colleagues and family whose support and collaboration have shaped my career.”


Since becoming president and chief executive officer of Ingevity in April 2025, Mr. Li has led a pivotal period in the company’s history, including its 10th anniversary as a public company. He has championed efforts to strengthen Ingevity’s position as a focused specialty materials company by advancing portfolio optimization, driving operational excellence and reinforcing a customer-centric approach to innovation. Under his leadership, Ingevity continues to build on its legacy of science, technology and technical expertise to solve complex challenges across the markets it serves and position the company for sustainable growth. His leadership emphasizes empowering teams, fostering innovation and building high-performance cultures that deliver lasting value for customers, shareholders and society.


“The Winthrop-Sears Medal recognizes entrepreneurial achievement that strengthens our industry. David’s work at CMC Materials and now at Ingevity reflects that: clear strategic choices, disciplined execution and a focus on technologies that solve real problems for customers and society,” said Dr. Roland Stefandl, President of The Chemists’ Club. “We are thrilled to be able to honor him during our annual Egg Nog celebration.”


David H. Li joins a distinguished group of individuals, including recent Winthrop-Sears honorees Joseph Martinko (Chemours, 2025), Yvonne van der Laan (LyondellBasell, 2024), Albert and James Chao (Westlake, 2023), and Dr. Robert Zeller (Oxy Low Carbon Ventures, 2022).


### About Ingevity


Ingevity (NYSE: NGVT) is a global specialty materials company that develops advanced carbon and engineered materials solutions that improve mobility, strengthen and extend the life of infrastructure and enhance industrial processes. With a century of innovation, we work closely with customers to solve technical challenges and deliver materials that improve performance and environmental outcomes in essential applications. Our portfolio includes Performance Materials activated carbon technologies for emissions control and filtration; Pavement Technologies solutions for high-performance pavement applications and dispersants for crop protection; and Advanced Polymer Technologies specialty polymers for coatings and industrial applications. Headquartered in North Charleston, South Carolina, Ingevity operates from 17 locations worldwide and employs approximately 1,400 people. Learn more at[ingevity.com](https://www.ingevity.com/) .


### About the Award


The Winthrop-Sears medal, established in 1970, is presented annually to recognize individuals who, through their entrepreneurial achievement, have contributed to the vitality of the chemical industry and the betterment of humanity. The medal is named in honor of two of America’s earliest chemical industry entrepreneurs, John Winthrop, Jr. and John Sears, and is presented at the Chemists’ Club’s annual Egg Nog Gala.


### About The Chemists’ Club


Founded in 1898, The Chemists’ Club is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit educational organization open to any individuals with an interest in the chemical sciences—including chemists, industry professionals across sectors, academics, and students. The Club offers members networking opportunities across the chemical process sector and supports the field’s future by connecting higher education students with career paths in the chemical industry today. For more information about The Chemists’ Club:[www.thechemistsclub.org](http://www.thechemistsclub.org/)
